title: Georgia races and candidates
description: Every Georgia race on the ballot and the candidates who qualified for it, by election cycle, as the Secretary of State publishes them.
updateCadence: As the Secretary of State publishes qualifying and ballot changes.
source: the Georgia Secretary of State; the county Census figures in early-vote/ come from the U.S. Census Bureau's American Community Survey, compiled by Georgia Civic Data (georgiacivicdata.org, CC BY 4.0)
